method: top-down TAM, bottom-up SAM, SOM 2% of SAM in 3 years

inputs.name: Nigerian small and medium firms
inputs.source: IFC, Nigeria MSME Finance Market Bite, Nov 2022 (ifc.org/content/dam/ifc/doc/2023-delta/ifc-nigeria-msme-finance-market-bite-nov-2022.pdf), citing SMEDAN national MSME data

inputs.name: share of Nigerian small and medium firms that would buy
inputs.source: assumption: about 1 in 4 SMEs pays to advertise at least one vacancy a year; replace with an employer survey

inputs.name: spend a year each
inputs.source: assumption: 3 months a year of Employer Professional at NGN 45,000/month (draft price in the plans table) while hiring

inputs.name: paying SME employers in the launch states (Lagos, FCT, Rivers, Oyo, Ogun)
inputs.source: assumption: 30% of the 670,447 SMEs (IFC/SMEDAN) are in the 5 launch states, x the 25% that pay to hire; check against SMEDAN state tables

inputs.name: months a year per customer
inputs.source: assumption: an SME subscribes for 3 hiring months a year

inputs.name: price per month
inputs.source: assumption: Employer Professional NGN 45,000/month, the draft price in the plans table, pending commercial testing

inputs.name: Formal MSMEs in Nigeria
inputs.source: IFC, Nigeria MSME Finance Market Bite, Nov 2022 (ifc.org/content/dam/ifc/doc/2023-delta/ifc-nigeria-msme-finance-market-bite-nov-2022.pdf), citing SMEDAN national MSME data

inputs.name: Informal MSMEs in Nigeria
inputs.source: IFC, Nigeria MSME Finance Market Bite, Nov 2022 (ifc.org/content/dam/ifc/doc/2023-delta/ifc-nigeria-msme-finance-market-bite-nov-2022.pdf), citing SMEDAN national MSME data

inputs.name: Small and medium firms in Nigeria
inputs.source: IFC, Nigeria MSME Finance Market Bite, Nov 2022 (ifc.org/content/dam/ifc/doc/2023-delta/ifc-nigeria-msme-finance-market-bite-nov-2022.pdf), citing SMEDAN national MSME data

formulas.tam: 670,447 Nigerian small and medium firms x 25% x NGN 135,000 = NGN 22,627,586,250
formulas.sam: 50,284 paying SME employers in the launch states (Lagos, FCT, Rivers, Oyo, Ogun) x 3 months a year x NGN 45,000 = NGN 6,788,340,000

som_reason: Verified-employer listings win SMEs whose openings get buried among fake jobs on Indeed and whose recruiters get locked out of LinkedIn: about 1,000 paying employers in the five launch states by year 3, reached through SME associations, NYSC and university career fairs and the Business Hub
